action.objective: Verify the reserved candidate e5e4 at maximum depth to see if it is a safe, commit-ready improvement over the last move.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search rated e5e4 highest (948, exact) with PV e5e4 f7g8 g4g5. Sliding the rook to e4 keeps it active and off the d-file where the Black rook could harass it, and supports a later g4-g5 push. The reserved verification budget (2000 nodes) is specifically for e5e4. This single-candidate verification will confirm safety (no Black mate-in-one or short forcing mate) and give depth-4 evidence before committing.
